title: Conditional Independence Graph Learning from Dependent Data Via Time-Delay Embedding
abstract: arXiv:2611.34616v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider the problem of inferring the conditional independence graph (CIG) of a high-dimensional stationary multivariate Gaussian time series which could be short-range dependent (SRD) or long-range dependent (LRD). In a time series graph, each component of the vector series is represented by a distinct node, and associations between components are represented by edges between the corresponding nodes. We consider a time-domain approach based on time-delay embedding, casting the problem as one of multi-attribute graph estimation for random vectors where a vector is associated with each node of the graph. For an embedding dimension $d$, at each node the associated $(d+1)$-dimensional random vector consists of a time series component and its $d$ delayed copies, with integer delays up to $d \ge 1$. translated_title: 基于时滞嵌入的相依数据条件独立图学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究高维平稳多元高斯时间序列的条件独立图（CIG）推断问题，该时间序列可以是短程相依（SRD）或长程相依（LRD）的。在时间序列图中，向量序列的每个分量由一个不同的节点表示，分量之间的关联由相应节点之间的边表示。我们考虑一种基于时滞嵌入的时域方法，将问题转化为随机向量的多属性图估计问题，其中图的每个节点都关联一个随机向量。对于嵌入维度 $d$，每个节点所关联的 $(d+1)$ 维随机向量由一个时间序列分量及其 $d$ 个延迟副本组成，延迟为不超过 $d \ge 1$ 的整数延迟。以往对相依数据的图估计研究多采用频域方法，但其分析仅限于短程相依数据。
tldr: 提出一种基于时滞嵌入的时域方法，将相依时间序列的条件独立图估计转化为多属性随机向量图估计问题，突破了以往频域方法仅适用于短程相依数据的限制，可同时处理短程相依和长程相依的高维平稳多元高斯时间序列。
en_tdlr: Proposes a time-domain approach based on time-delay embedding that casts conditional independence graph estimation for dependent time series as multi-attribute random vector graph estimation, overcoming the limitation of prior frequency-domain methods restricted to short-range dependent data and handling both SRD and LRD high-dimensional stationary multivariate Gaussian time series.
